sources.entry: Input Source Pro - Input Source Pro is macOS utility designed for multilingual users who frequently switch input sources.

summary.one_liner: Input Source Pro is a free, open-source macOS utility that automatically switches keyboard input sources based on the active app or browser website.
summary.what_it_does: It sets a default input source per application and per website when using supported browsers, and switches automatically as the user moves between apps and sites. It shows an on-screen indicator of the current input source. It can force English punctuation in selected apps so symbols are typed as standard characters even when a localized input source is active. It can switch the macOS function key mode (standard F1–F12 or media keys) per app, falling back to the system setting when no override exists. Input sources can be changed through keyboard shortcuts or modifier-key shortcuts such as a single or double tap of Shift or Command.
use_cases: automatically switch keyboard layout per app
set different input language per website
keep punctuation in English inside code editors or terminals
switch function key mode per application
quickly toggle input sources with a keyboard shortcut
how_to_run: Or download the latest release from the Releases page
Open the project in Xcode and hit Build (requires Xcode 27 or later, Swift 6.4 or later)
notable: Per-website input source switching for multiple browsers, including Safari, Chrome, Arc, Edge, Firefox and others
Force English Punctuation mode for chosen apps
Per-app function key mode (standard F-keys or media keys)
Modifier-only shortcuts triggered by single or double tap
caveats: Requires macOS; building from source needs Xcode 27 or later and Swift 6.4 or later
Website-level switching applies only to the listed browsers
